note: The Atlas engine is built from the public Enntity/atlas fork at this exact commit; build.sh refuses any other tree.

upstream_candidate.note: The RC4.2 upstream candidate upstream/glm53-flash-20261012-rc4.2 (d8a55e0f) plus three vision commits: image prompts keyed by content for the prefix cache (each placeholder becomes an id derived from its image's SHA-256 hash and its index, so different images never share KV and a re-sent image hits; Atlas issue 58), TP workers load no vision weights (rank 0 encodes and broadcasts the rows), and per-sequence vision state with per-chunk encoding (only images a chunk computes go through the ViT; image prompts interleave without sharing encoder rows).

sparkglm_only.note: The seven SparkGLM-only commits re-applied on the vision upstream candidate (08c07e96..fc58aaac, unchanged from RC4.2's 26812d35..dfb9c26a): FlashKDA/native sparse-MLA prefill bridges, GB10 display-carveout KV placement (latent pools only, ATLAS_KV_CARVEOUT_ORDER), and sharded latent pools (ATLAS_GLM_KV_SHARD, opt-in through SPARKGLM_KV_SHARD) sized and placed in the carveout. Fork-only; the carveout is used only with DISPLAY_CARVEOUT=1.

integration.note: The previous pin (fix/sparkglm-rc4.2-refusal-content 6f27e8fa) plus the three vision commits, layered: tree 0f1b58bd is identical to the tested feat/vision-prefix-cache a699ffec. RC4's decode path is unchanged.

refusal_content.note: The refusal-content fix (6f27e8fa on RC4.2, Atlas-Inf issue 172) re-applied on top: the full blocking assistant content is preserved alongside the refusal metadata.
